status: Versioned main-branch release qualification in progress
changes: Add continuous reading for long notes, whole-document search and Markdown copy.
Add Riwaq Day/Night themes, bundled open Arabic fonts and improved mixed RTL/LTR layout.
Add manual signed update checks, downloads and explicit installation/restart.
Fix TeX rendering, Shell/SQLite guide setup, two-way Split scrolling and PDF font discovery.
Address reviewed dependency advisories with checked source provenance and regressions.

source.scope: All PR heads are preserved in main. The versioned release requires its own full main-branch CI; previous candidate binaries are not relabeled as release packages.

hostedCI.status: pending; run after the versioned source is on main

security.localOverrides: Registry audits do not certify local source dependencies. Exact source/patch provenance and mandatory native/JavaScript regressions remain enforced; raw upstream JavaScript findings remain visible. See dependency-overrides.json.
security.licenses: Required source licenses, patched dependency notices and bundled font notices remain; build-generated attributions stay in artifacts and packages.

manualUpdates.policy: No startup checks, automatic downloads, installation or restart; each step requires an explicit action.

channels.macOS: Pinned, version-bound signature; universal app archive; explicit install and restart.
channels.Linux: Pinned, version-bound signature; amd64 DEB; OS installer approval and explicit version-checked restart.

manualUpdates.security: Fixed HTTPS GitHub feed and asset hosts; bounded downloads; no document paths or text transmitted; closed native commands; production private key held outside source and in encrypted Actions secret.
manualUpdates.bootstrap: This is the first update-capable release. Existing installations need one manual upgrade using the installer or release downloads.
manualUpdates.installedUpgradeQualification: Actual privileged DEB approval/restart and macOS replacement/restart require a controlled installed-release upgrade. Test fixtures never update this workstation.

continuousReader.behavior: One continuous reader with whole-note semantic text for ordinary documents, measured buffered content for large documents, lazy nearby rich output and whole-document Markdown copy. Parser context, native byte provenance, grants and Source undo remain unchanged.
limits: Virtual large-document views expose nearby semantic text. Complete standalone HTML remains available; physical screen-reader/IME certification and GNOME activation policy are Not Run.

Live manual selections retain a bounded window. A notice preserves the selection before further scrolling would discard it; Select All/Copy and Copy document Markdown include the full native revision.
Parser/context/output admission limits and bounded source fallbacks remain in force. Debug scroll observations include WebDriver/IPC polling and are not physical paint or input-latency measurements.

remainingQualifications: Native Intel runtime and minimum-supported macOS verification; both universal slices compile and validate as desktop MACOS, while hosted runtime coverage is ARM64
Physical IME, screen-reader speech/navigation, keyboard/image integration, font dialogs, HiDPI and printing
Full installed Ubuntu desktop qualification; installed-package UI checks use isolated hosted and offline runtime desktops
Sustained large Source, multitab, Git/Review resource distributions and compositor/input-to-paint/DOM/IPC measurements
Broader filesystem/Git/storage/crash faults, converters/fonts/layout and tool-version combinations
Downloaded macOS opening/Gatekeeper and clean-machine channel verification
Actual installed-release update approval/replacement and restart on each supported OS; automated signature, cancellation and version-bound checks do not certify privileged OS installation.

distributionDecision.macOS: ad-hoc signing; no paid Apple Developer account
distributionDecision.notarization: not planned for the selected channel
distributionDecision.opening: macOS may block downloaded apps; per-app user trust decision remains necessary; no automatic Gatekeeper/quarantine bypass

evidencePolicy: Results apply only to their recorded executable, source, host and scope. Raw local traces and failed runs remain in ignored artifacts; maintained tests, provenance and legal notices remain in source. No ignored advisory, release evaluator or physical-input inference.

historicalEvidence.scope: Prior binary-bound measurements and failed local traces keep their original scope and are not relabeled as current-release performance.
